Callout.Name: Suspicious Package
Callout.Message: Unattended bag reported outside a building.
Callout.Advisory: No persons near it, staff clearing the building themselves.

Script.Line: It was there at eight this morning and it is still there now.
Nobody has been near it. We cleared the building ourselves.
Do not open it. I am asking you not to open it.

Lines.Approach: Nobody near it and the staff are clearing the building themselves. Do not go poking at it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
